OpenAI Executive Warns of Dangerous AI, Urges Government Oversight

An executive from OpenAI has issued a stark warning about the potential dangers of artificial intelligence, stating that the technology is "unquestionably dangerous." The executive urged governments worldwide to accelerate their oversight and regulation of AI safety, suggesting that current governmental responses are too slow. This call for increased regulation comes amid growing concerns about the rapid advancement and potential misuse of AI technologies.
